The strongest positives are program-specific and often filtered through IMF, World Bank, or UN partnership reporting rather than a transparent Egyptian government monitoring system.","evidence":[{"title":"Arab Republic of Egypt: Technical Assistance Report - Public Investment Management Assessment","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-04-02","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/technical-assistance-reports/issues/2024/04/02/arab-republic-of-egypt-technical-assistance-report-public-investment-management-assessment-547051","summary":"Egypt had already taken steps to improve infrastructure access and public investment management through new legislation, new information systems, and staff-capacity work; the report also ties this to Education 2.0 and health-infrastructure rollout. This is strong negative evidence on avoiding suffering during conflict displacement.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3","6B.2"]},{"title":"Egypt: Halt crackdown on people voicing concerns over economic crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/","summary":"Authorities arrested protesters, striking workers, and online critics over economic discontent, and did not properly investigate abuse complaints.
